## What's new in Igggy 0.1.19
- **No more blank page when you start recording.** After you press Record, a single line tells you what's actually happening: opening your Google Meet, Zoom or Teams call, then listening. The meeting's brief stays on screen while it's quiet, and when people start talking, their words take over. - **Watch your note being written.** After Write notes, the conversation stays on the page and a line under it names the step Igggy is on, such as telling the speakers apart or reading the conversation, with time left. - **A brief that reads like a note.** Before a meeting, the brief shows what you covered last time and what's still open, in a couple of lines. "Show the full brief" opens the rest. - **Smoother live conversation.** Chat bubbles grow gently as people talk, and words fade in instead of snapping. - **Setup ends on Today.** When you finish setting up, Igggy opens on Today, with the welcome note waiting in the sidebar. - **Your recording shortcut, everywhere.** Hover over Record new note to see your shortcut. ⌘R starts a recording from any screen, and you can change Igggy's keyboard shortcuts in Settings → General. - **Attendee details at a glance.** Hover over an attendee's circle to see their name. Click it for their email. - **Polish.** Clearer controls on the recording page and in the writing queue.
